   - Person has at least one condition occurrence of a concept in the “Constipation” concept set during the time window (past year, see Assumptions).
   - No restrictions on age, sex, race, or other demographics.
   - No requirement for prior observation or minimum continuous enrollment.

   - One record per person: include each person once, using the first qualifying constipation condition occurrence within the time window as the index event. This cohort is intended to count unique patients with constipation in the time window.

4) Visit / setting / provider grouping
   - Condition occurrence may be recorded in any care setting (inpatient, outpatient, emergency department, telehealth, etc.). Do not restrict by visit type.
   - Grouping dimension requested: provider. Attribute the index event to the provider as follows:
